```lean
theorem lg_target {n a : ℕ} : (∃ x, x ^ n = a) ↔ n = 0 ∧ a = 1 ∨ n ≠ 0 ∧ n.nthRoot a ^ n = a := by
  split
  · intro h
    cases h with x hx
    split
    · left
      exact eq_zero_of_eq_one (nat.eq_one_of_pow_eq_one hx)
    · right
      exact ne_of_gt (nat.nth_root_pos _ _).ne'
  · intro h
    cases h with h1 h2
    left
    refine ⟨_, _⟩
    · exact (nat.nth_root _ _).to_nat
    · rw [h1]
      exact pow_eq_self (nat.nth_root _ _).to_nat h2
```
